result.instructions: Tools for ReciPal, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my recipes contain milk or tree nuts?"; "Copy my Granola Bar recipe, scale it 5x and call it Granola Bar Batch."; "Which raw materials will run out within three weeks?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ReciPal data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run recipal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run recipal_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run recipal_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. recipal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: recipal_list_recipes
tools.title: List recipes
tools.description: List your recipes (products) with yield, servings, cost per batch/package and the headline per-serving nutrition (calories, fat, sodium, carbohydrate, protein). Sorted by last update by default. Set full=true for the complete object with every nutrient. Pages of up to 20; a page with fewer rows is the last. GET /recipes.

full.description: Return every recipe field including all ~80 nutrients (large). Default false.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: recipal_get_recipe
tools.title: Get recipe
tools.description: One recipe in full: yield, servings, packages, allergens, costs (ingredient + packaging/labor/overhead), ingredient list, tags, primary label path and the complete per-serving nutrition. GET /recipes/{id}.

tools.name: recipal_list_recipe_ingredients
tools.title: List recipe ingredients
tools.description: The formula of one recipe: every recipe ingredient line with ingredient id, name, quantity, unit, waste %, total grams and the display name per label language. Use the line ids with recipal_update_recipe_ingredient. GET /recipes/{id}/recipe_ingredients.

tools.name: recipal_get_recipe_ingredient
tools.title: Get recipe ingredient
tools.description: One ingredient line of a recipe, including units_and_grams (the units you can use for it, each with its weight in grams). GET /recipes/{recipe_id}/recipe_ingredients/{id}.

tools.name: recipal_list_ingredients
tools.title: List ingredients
tools.description: List your own ingredients (custom and subrecipe ingredients) with allergens, units and headline nutrition per 100 g. Set full=true for every nutrient. Archived ones are hidden unless asked for. GET /ingredients.

full.description: Return every ingredient field including all nutrients (large). Default false.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: recipal_get_ingredient
tools.title: Get ingredient
tools.description: One ingredient in full (yours or a public one): allergens, ingredient-list text, custom units, and every nutrient per 100 grams. GET /ingredients/{id}.

tools.name: recipal_list_ingredient_costs
tools.title: List costs of an ingredient
tools.description: The cost history of one ingredient: effective date, quantity, unit, price and shipping per entry (the entry with the latest effective_at not in the future is the active one). GET /ingredients/{id}/ingredient_costs.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: recipal_list_current_ingredient_costs
tools.title: List current ingredient costs
tools.description: The currently active cost of every ingredient (one entry per ingredient): price, shipping, quantity and unit. GET /ingredient_costs.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: recipal_get_ingredient_cost
tools.title: Get ingredient cost
tools.description: One ingredient cost entry by id. GET /ingredient_costs/{id}.

tools.name: recipal_get_label
tools.title: Get label
tools.description: A recipe's saved nutrition-facts label settings (format, which rows show, styling) plus the computed nutrition claims (e.g. Fat Free) and ingredient list per language. The token is the last part of the recipe's primary_label path (/api/v1/labels/{token}). Optionally compute claims and ingredient list for another format. GET /labels/{token}.

label_token.description: Label token from the recipe's primary_label path.

result_format.description: Compute claims and ingredient list for this format instead of the saved one, e.g. legacy_fda/adult/vertical.

tools.name: recipal_start_label_render
tools.title: Start label render
tools.description: WRITE (render job): start rendering a recipe's nutrition label as a PDF or PNG and return the render status with a token. Always asynchronous: poll recipal_get_label_render_status with the token until status is ready, then give the user the temporary download url. Each account may run 5 renders in parallel. GET /recipes/{id}/label.pdf|label.png?async=true.

page_size.description: PDF only: "auto" (default) crops to the label, or letter, legal, A4.

zoom.description: PNG only: scale from 0.8 to 6 (default 3); larger = crisper, bigger image.

tools.name: recipal_get_label_render_status
tools.title: Get label render status
tools.description: Status of a label render started with recipal_start_label_render: waiting, processing, ready or error. When ready, url is a temporary presigned download link. Poll about once a second; each poll counts toward the weekly request limit. GET /recipes/label_renders/{token}.

tools.name: recipal_list_inventories
tools.title: List raw-material inventory
tools.description: Raw-material (ingredient) stock rows: quantity on hand, weeks remaining, daily consumption, quantity on order, reorder risk (safe, warning, critical), reorder level and the on-hand value. Needs an inventory plan (otherwise 403 INVENTORY_PLAN_REQUIRED). By default sorted by weeks remaining, lowest first. GET /inventories.

q.description: Case-insensitive search in the ingredient name.

tags.description: Only rows whose ingredient has ALL these tags.

supplier_id.description: Only rows linked to this supplier.

sort_direction.description: "asc" (default), "desc", or "mid" (warning band first, then critical, then safe; only for weeks_remaining and risk).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: recipal_get_inventory
tools.title: Get raw-material inventory row
tools.description: One raw-material stock row by id (quantity, unit, weeks remaining, reorder guideline, on-hand value). Needs an inventory plan. GET /inventories/{id}.

tools.name: recipal_list_inventory_tags
tools.title: List ingredient tags
tools.description: Ingredient tags in use with the number of ingredients carrying each, most used first. Use them to filter recipal_list_inventories. Needs an inventory plan. GET /inventories/tags.

tools.name: recipal_list_finished_goods
tools.title: List finished goods inventory
tools.description: Finished-goods stock rows: recipe, quantity on hand, unit, total packages, lot-code settings, case/pallet sizes and the on-hand value. Needs an inventory plan. GET /finished_goods.

q.description: Case-insensitive search in the recipe name.

tags.description: Only rows whose recipe has ALL these tags.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: recipal_get_finished_good
tools.title: Get finished goods row
tools.description: One finished-goods stock row by id. Needs an inventory plan. GET /finished_goods/{id}.

tools.name: recipal_list_finished_good_tags
tools.title: List recipe tags
tools.description: Recipe tags in use with the number of recipes carrying each, most used first. Use them to filter recipal_list_finished_goods. Needs an inventory plan. GET /finished_goods/tags.

tools.name: recipal_create_recipe
tools.title: Create recipe
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty recipe (add ingredient lines with recipal_add_recipe_ingredient, or use recipal_create_recipe_from_ingredients to do both at once). All fields are optional. Creates a record in your ReciPal account; it counts against the plan's recipe allowance. POST /recipes.

package_yield_unit.description: Unit of the finished package weight: "grams" (default), "ounces", "mL" or "fluid ounces".

suggested_serving.description: Suggested serving in common terms, e.g. "1 piece or 1 cup".

visual_unit_of_measure.description: Visual reference after the metric serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "5 chips".

prepared_serving_note.description: Note after the serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "makes 1 cup prepared".

packages.description: Number of packages the recipe yields per batch (0 or more).

allergens.description: Allergens by name, e.g. {"Milk": true, "Almond": true, "other-shellfish": "Oyster"}. Standard names: Wheat, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame, Mustard, Sulfites, Milk (Goat milk, Sheep milk), Egg (Duck egg, Quail egg), Fish (Tuna, Cod, Salmon, Bass), Shellfish (Crab, Lobster, Shrimp), tree nuts (Almond, Cashew, Hazelnut, Macadamia nut, Pecan, Pine nut, Pistachio, Walnut ...), Gluten (Barley, Oats, Rye, Triticale). other-milk/-egg/-fish/-shellfish/-treenut take a free-text source. An empty object {} clears all allergens.

packaging_cost.description: Cost per package of direct and secondary packaging.

overhead_cost.description: Overhead cost per batch (rent, electricity, equipment ...).

subrecipe_name.description: Name shown when this recipe is used as a subrecipe in another recipe's ingredient list.

subrecipe_name_french.description: French name shown when used as a subrecipe.

package_yield_quantity.description: Net weight of each finished package, in package_yield_unit (default 0).

ingredient_list.description: Ingredient list text for the label.

tools.name: recipal_update_recipe
tools.title: Update recipe
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one recipe; fields you leave out stay unchanged. package_yield_quantity "default" sets the package weight to the total weight of the current ingredients (no moisture loss accounted for); ingredient_list "default" rebuilds the label ingredient list in descending weight order. Changes labels and costs of this recipe. Tags cannot be set here. PUT /recipes/{id}.

package_yield_unit.description: Unit of the finished package weight: "grams" (default), "ounces", "mL" or "fluid ounces".

suggested_serving.description: Suggested serving in common terms, e.g. "1 piece or 1 cup".

visual_unit_of_measure.description: Visual reference after the metric serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "5 chips".

prepared_serving_note.description: Note after the serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "makes 1 cup prepared".

packages.description: Number of packages the recipe yields per batch (0 or more).

allergens.description: Allergens by name, e.g. {"Milk": true, "Almond": true, "other-shellfish": "Oyster"}. Standard names: Wheat, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame, Mustard, Sulfites, Milk (Goat milk, Sheep milk), Egg (Duck egg, Quail egg), Fish (Tuna, Cod, Salmon, Bass), Shellfish (Crab, Lobster, Shrimp), tree nuts (Almond, Cashew, Hazelnut, Macadamia nut, Pecan, Pine nut, Pistachio, Walnut ...), Gluten (Barley, Oats, Rye, Triticale). other-milk/-egg/-fish/-shellfish/-treenut take a free-text source. An empty object {} clears all allergens.

packaging_cost.description: Cost per package of direct and secondary packaging.

overhead_cost.description: Overhead cost per batch (rent, electricity, equipment ...).

subrecipe_name.description: Name shown when this recipe is used as a subrecipe in another recipe's ingredient list.

subrecipe_name_french.description: French name shown when used as a subrecipe.

package_yield_quantity.description: Net weight of each finished package in package_yield_unit, or "default" to total the ingredient weights.

ingredient_list.description: Ingredient list text for the label, or "default" to rebuild it from the ingredients.

tools.name: recipal_scale_recipe
tools.title: Copy or scale recipe
tools.description: WRITE: create a NEW recipe as a copy of an existing one, with every ingredient quantity and the yield multiplied by scale_amount (1 = plain copy; per-serving nutrition stays the same; scaling down cannot take packages below 1). Costs and tags carry over. The original is not changed. Without a name the copy is called "<name> (copy)" or "<name> <n>x". POST /recipes/{id}/scale.

tools.name: recipal_create_recipe_from_ingredients
tools.title: Create recipe with ingredients
tools.description: WRITE: create a new recipe and its ingredient lines in one call. ingredients lists ingredient ids with the weight of each in grams. Optional yield, servings and packaging fields as in recipal_create_recipe. Creates a record in your ReciPal account. POST /recipes/shortcut.

ingredients.description: Ingredient ids with their weights in grams (1-100 lines).

package_yield_unit.description: Unit of the finished package weight: "grams" (default), "ounces", "mL" or "fluid ounces".

suggested_serving.description: Suggested serving in common terms, e.g. "1 piece or 1 cup".

visual_unit_of_measure.description: Visual reference after the metric serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "5 chips".

prepared_serving_note.description: Note after the serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "makes 1 cup prepared".

packages.description: Number of packages the recipe yields per batch (0 or more).

allergens.description: Allergens by name, e.g. {"Milk": true, "Almond": true, "other-shellfish": "Oyster"}. Standard names: Wheat, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame, Mustard, Sulfites, Milk (Goat milk, Sheep milk), Egg (Duck egg, Quail egg), Fish (Tuna, Cod, Salmon, Bass), Shellfish (Crab, Lobster, Shrimp), tree nuts (Almond, Cashew, Hazelnut, Macadamia nut, Pecan, Pine nut, Pistachio, Walnut ...), Gluten (Barley, Oats, Rye, Triticale). other-milk/-egg/-fish/-shellfish/-treenut take a free-text source. An empty object {} clears all allergens.

packaging_cost.description: Cost per package of direct and secondary packaging.

overhead_cost.description: Overhead cost per batch (rent, electricity, equipment ...).

subrecipe_name.description: Name shown when this recipe is used as a subrecipe in another recipe's ingredient list.

subrecipe_name_french.description: French name shown when used as a subrecipe.

package_yield_quantity.description: Net weight of each finished package, in package_yield_unit (default 0).

ingredient_list.description: Ingredient list text for the label.

tools.name: recipal_create_subrecipe
tools.title: Turn recipe into subrecipe
tools.description: WRITE: turn a recipe into an ingredient (a subrecipe) with its nutrition, costing and ingredient list, so it can be used inside other recipes. Later changes to the recipe flow through to the ingredient. Fails if the recipe is empty. Returns the new ingredient. POST /recipes/{id}/create_subrecipe.

recipe_id.description: Recipe to turn into a subrecipe.

tools.name: recipal_add_recipe_ingredient
tools.title: Add ingredient to recipe
tools.description: WRITE: add an ingredient line to a recipe, by unit and quantity (the unit must be one the ingredient offers, e.g. "1 cup" or "1 gram"; see units_and_grams from recipal_get_recipe_ingredient or valid_units from recipal_get_ingredient) or directly by total_grams (overrides unit and quantity). Changes the recipe's nutrition, label and cost. POST /recipes/{id}/recipe_ingredients.

unit.description: Unit of the ingredient (default: its first unit).

waste.description: Percent of the ingredient that does not go into the product (0-100). Costed in full, excluded from nutrition.

total_grams.description: Weight in grams; overrides unit and quantity.

tools.name: recipal_update_recipe_ingredient
tools.title: Update recipe ingredient amount
tools.description: WRITE: change the AMOUNT of one ingredient line in a recipe (unit, quantity, waste or total_grams; total_grams overrides unit and quantity). It cannot swap the ingredient: remove the line and add another instead. Changes the recipe's nutrition, label and cost. PUT /recipes/{recipe_id}/recipe_ingredients/{id}.

unit.description: Unit, one of the ingredient's units.

total_grams.description: Weight in grams; overrides unit and quantity.

tools.name: recipal_remove_recipe_ingredient
tools.title: Remove ingredient from recipe
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): permanently remove one ingredient line from a recipe. It cannot be undone, but the same ingredient can be added back (with recipal_add_recipe_ingredient). Changes the recipe's nutrition, label and cost. The ingredient itself is not deleted. DELETE /recipes/{recipe_id}/recipe_ingredients/{id}.

tools.name: recipal_create_ingredient
tools.title: Create ingredient
tools.description: WRITE: create a custom ingredient (private to your account) with its nutrition facts. For a food ingredient give nutrition_unit and nutrition_quantity (the serving the nutrients are entered for, e.g. 1 cup; for units beyond gram/oz/lb/kg add them in measures first) and all required nutrients. food and non_food cannot be changed later. Non-food items: set food=false and non_food to labor, packaging, safety, other_hourly or other_fixed. POST /ingredients.

brand.description: Brand name, mainly to verify data.

source.description: Data source: URL, supplier or recipe id.

food.description: true (default) for a food ingredient; false for a non-food item.

nutrition_unit.description: Required for food and safety ingredients. Food: the unit the nutrients are entered in (gram, oz, lb, kg, "100 grams", a unit from measures, or a volume unit such as cup once measures includes a volume). Safety: deg_f, deg_c, ph, brix, aw, seconds, minutes, hours, psi, ppm, percent, pass_fail or each.

nutrition_quantity.description: Required for food ingredients: quantity of nutrition_unit the nutrients are for, e.g. 0.5 for 0.5 cup.

measures.description: Custom units, e.g. [{quantity:1, unit:'cup', equivalent_quantity:240, equivalent_unit:'gram'}].

quantity.description: How many of `unit` the measure describes (e.g. 1).

unit.description: Name of the unit, e.g. "cookie" or "cup". Not gram, oz, lb or kg (every ingredient has those).

equivalent_quantity.description: How much of equivalent_unit that many units equal (e.g. 20).

equivalent_unit.description: gram, oz, lb, kg, or another measure's unit.

ingredient_list.description: Ingredient list text as it appears on a label, e.g. "Curlies (Milk, Sugar)".

allergens.description: Allergens by name, e.g. {"Milk": true, "Almond": true, "other-shellfish": "Oyster"}. Standard names: Wheat, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame, Mustard, Sulfites, Milk (Goat milk, Sheep milk), Egg (Duck egg, Quail egg), Fish (Tuna, Cod, Salmon, Bass), Shellfish (Crab, Lobster, Shrimp), tree nuts (Almond, Cashew, Hazelnut, Macadamia nut, Pecan, Pine nut, Pistachio, Walnut ...), Gluten (Barley, Oats, Rye, Triticale). other-milk/-egg/-fish/-shellfish/-treenut take a free-text source. An empty object {} clears all allergens.

nutrients.description: Nutrition facts (food ingredients only). Amounts per serving (nutrition_quantity x nutrition_unit): calories; grams for protein, fat, fat_saturated, fat_trans, carbohydrate, fiber, uncounted_fiber, sugar, added_sugar, sugar_alcohol, fat_monounsaturated, fat_polyunsaturated, omega_3, omega_6, water, ash; milligrams for cholesterol, sodium, calcium, iron, potassium, vitamin_c, vitamin_e, thiamin, riboflavin, niacin, vitamin_b6, pantothenic_acid, phosphorus, magnesium, zinc, copper, manganese, chloride, choline; micrograms for vitamin_k, folate, vitamin_b12, biotin, iodine, selenium, chromium, molybdenum; IU for vitamin_d_IU and vitamin_a_IU. Required for a food ingredient: calories, protein, fat, fat_saturated, fat_trans, cholesterol, carbohydrate, fiber, sugar, added_sugar, sodium, calcium, iron, vitamin_a_IU, vitamin_c.

tools.name: recipal_update_ingredient
tools.title: Update ingredient
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one of YOUR ingredients (public ingredients cannot be edited); fields you leave out stay unchanged. If nutrition_unit, nutrition_quantity or their measure change, nutrients you do not pass are rescaled to keep the same amount per serving. measures REPLACES the whole list of custom units, so send them all. Setting archived true hides the ingredient from lists; false restores it. The change flows into every recipe using the ingredient. PUT /ingredients/{id}.

nutrition_unit.description: Unit the nutrients are entered in.

nutrition_quantity.description: Quantity of nutrition_unit the nutrients are for.

measures.description: The FULL list of custom units (replaces the existing list).

quantity.description: How many of `unit` the measure describes (e.g. 1).

unit.description: Name of the unit, e.g. "cookie" or "cup". Not gram, oz, lb or kg (every ingredient has those).

equivalent_quantity.description: How much of equivalent_unit that many units equal (e.g. 20).

equivalent_unit.description: gram, oz, lb, kg, or another measure's unit.

allergens.description: Allergens by name, e.g. {"Milk": true, "Almond": true, "other-shellfish": "Oyster"}. Standard names: Wheat, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame, Mustard, Sulfites, Milk (Goat milk, Sheep milk), Egg (Duck egg, Quail egg), Fish (Tuna, Cod, Salmon, Bass), Shellfish (Crab, Lobster, Shrimp), tree nuts (Almond, Cashew, Hazelnut, Macadamia nut, Pecan, Pine nut, Pistachio, Walnut ...), Gluten (Barley, Oats, Rye, Triticale). other-milk/-egg/-fish/-shellfish/-treenut take a free-text source. An empty object {} clears all allergens.

archived.description: true to archive, false to restore.

nutrients.description: Nutrition facts to change; others are kept. Amounts per serving (nutrition_quantity x nutrition_unit): calories; grams for protein, fat, fat_saturated, fat_trans, carbohydrate, fiber, uncounted_fiber, sugar, added_sugar, sugar_alcohol, fat_monounsaturated, fat_polyunsaturated, omega_3, omega_6, water, ash; milligrams for cholesterol, sodium, calcium, iron, potassium, vitamin_c, vitamin_e, thiamin, riboflavin, niacin, vitamin_b6, pantothenic_acid, phosphorus, magnesium, zinc, copper, manganese, chloride, choline; micrograms for vitamin_k, folate, vitamin_b12, biotin, iodine, selenium, chromium, molybdenum; IU for vitamin_d_IU and vitamin_a_IU.

tools.name: recipal_create_ingredient_cost
tools.title: Add ingredient cost
tools.description: WRITE: add a price for an ingredient that becomes active on effective_at (the active cost is the one with the latest effective_at not after the date; one cost per ingredient per date). price and shipping are per quantity x unit. Changes the cost of every recipe using the ingredient from that date. Not allowed for subrecipe ingredients. POST /ingredient_costs.

effective_at.description: Date the cost becomes active, yyyy-mm-dd.

unit.description: A unit of the ingredient, e.g. "1 cup", "1 lb".

quantity.description: How much of the unit the price covers (default 0).

tools.name: recipal_update_ingredient_cost
tools.title: Update ingredient cost
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing ingredient cost entry (date, unit, quantity, price, shipping); fields you leave out stay unchanged. Changes recipe costs that depend on it. Not allowed for subrecipe ingredients. PUT /ingredient_costs/{id}.

effective_at.description: New effective date, yyyy-mm-dd (unique per ingredient).

quantity.description: How much of the unit the price covers.
